questions.stem: A 24-year-old male presents to the emergency room after a fall from a height, landing on his outstretched left wrist. He reports pain and tenderness in the region of the anatomical snuffbox of his left hand. An X-ray confirms a fracture of the scaphoid bone. Which of the following statements about the scaphoid bone is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Fracture of Scaphoid has a Low incidence of Non Union

options.label: B
options.text: Scaphoid Bone Articulates with Five Bones totally

options.label: C
options.text: Scaphoid Bone can be easily Immobilized

options.label: D
options.text: Fracture Line on the Scaphoid Bone may deprive the Distal Fragment of its Arterial Supply
